residency.test: Resident if domiciled in Sweden, if you stay continuously for six months, or if you have an essential connection after leaving (family, housing, business interests).
residency.sink: Non-residents working temporarily in Sweden can elect SINK, a 25% flat withholding with no deductions.
residency.expert_tax: The expert tax relief exempts 25% of remuneration for qualifying key personnel for up to seven years.

headline.municipal_tax: about 32.4% on average, set by each municipality and region
headline.state_tax: an extra 20% on taxable income above 625,800
headline.employee_contribution: 7% pension fee, fully offset by a tax credit for most people

local_tax.name: Kommunalskatt (municipal and regional tax)
local_tax.note: national average; ranges from about 29% in Österåker to 35.3% in Dorotea

personal_allowance.name: Grundavdrag
personal_allowance.note: ranges from about 16,900 to 45,500 depending on income; the higher amounts apply in the middle of the income range

credits.name: Jobbskatteavdrag (earned income tax credit)
credits.note: approximation of a formula tied to the price base amount and the municipal rate

employee.name: Allmän pensionsavgift
employee.note: offset in full by a tax credit for most taxpayers, so the real cost is usually zero

employer.name: Arbetsgivaravgifter
employer.note: reduced rates apply for young and older workers

capital_gains.rate: 30% on capital income, including interest, dividends and gains
capital_gains.listed_shares: 30%, but most private investors hold shares in an investeringssparkonto (ISK) instead
capital_gains.isk: the ISK is taxed on a deemed return on the account balance rather than on gains, which is usually far cheaper in rising markets
capital_gains.housing: 22/30 of the gain is taxed at 30%, giving an effective 22%; deferral is available when buying a replacement home

quirks: The investeringssparkonto (ISK) replaces capital gains tax with a small annual charge on the account value. For long-term investors this is the single most important account choice.
The employee pension fee of 7% is neutralised by a matching credit, so payslips understate the real position - almost nobody actually pays it.
Municipal rates differ by more than six percentage points across the country, which is a larger swing than most people expect within a single tax system.
The state tax threshold (skiktgräns) is the point where the marginal rate jumps from roughly 32% to roughly 52%, which is why Swedish salary negotiations often focus on benefits above that level.
The pre-filled return arrives in March and can be approved by SMS or app in under a minute if nothing needs changing.

reporting.who_must_file: Everyone who receives a tax return proposal, which is essentially every resident with income. Approving the pre-filled return counts as filing.

deadlines.what: Filing deadline for individuals for the 2025 income year
Approve by this date with no changes for the earliest refund, usually paid in April
Deadline for extra tax payments to avoid interest on large underpayments
Employer PAYE returns (arbetsgivardeklaration) with individual-level reporting

forms.name: Sale of property or tenant-owned apartment

documents_to_collect: The pre-filled return, which already contains salary, benefits, interest and most securities sales
Broker statements for anything not pre-filled, particularly foreign holdings
Documentation of property sale costs and improvement expenditure - these are not pre-filled and are frequently missed
Receipts for ROT and RUT home service deductions
Records of deductible travel to work above the annual threshold

penalties.late_filing: förseningsavgift of 1,250, rising to 3,750 in total for continued delay
penalties.incorrect_information: skattetillägg of 40% of the underpaid tax, 20% for capital income
penalties.interest: charged on underpayments above 30,000 from February

warnings: The grundavdrag and jobbskatteavdrag are both formula-driven and are approximated here; results in the 200,000-500,000 range are the least precise.
Church fee (about 1%) applies to members of the Church of Sweden and is not included.
Use the municipality's actual rate rather than the national average whenever it is known.
